subject: Add redis symlinks at the same place as the installed binaries (#193)
reason: The change is make install/uninstall machinery (redis-* compatibility symlinks) plus an argv[0] dispatch in main() that runs redis_check_rdb_main/redis_check_aof_main only when the binary is invoked under a redis-* name. Those names exist only as symlinks created by `make install`, which the fuzzer never runs: it executes servers and tools from the build tree under their valkey-* names, valkey.action.tools restricts `tool` to the four valkey-* names and uses the bare name as argv[0], and `files` writes plain files, not symlinks.
